created_roles.name: Data Analyst
created_roles.description: Expert in data aggregation and financial calculations. Responsible for transforming raw shipment metrics into total revenue figures.
created_roles.prompt: You are a Senior Data Analyst. Your task is to calculate the total revenue for each shipping lane. For each lane, multiply the number of loads by the average revenue per load. Double-check your multiplication. Output the results in a clean markdown table with columns 'Lane' and 'Total Revenue (USD)'.
created_roles.goal: Produce an accurate table of total revenue per lane.
responsibilities: Calculate total revenue for each lane

outputs.format: markdown table: Lane x Total Revenue

constraints: Must use the provided average and load counts

created_roles.name: Visualization Engineer
created_roles.description: Specialist in data visualization and Python-based charting. Responsible for verifying data integrity and rendering the final image.
created_roles.prompt: You are a Senior Visualization Engineer. First, verify the total revenue calculations provided by the Data Analyst against the raw shipment data. If they are correct, use Python (matplotlib or seaborn) to create a bar chart. The X-axis should be the Lane and the Y-axis should be the Total Revenue. Ensure the chart has a title 'Total Revenue per Lane' and clear axis labels. Save the final output as a PNG file.
created_roles.goal: Deliver a high-quality PNG bar chart of total revenue.
success_criteria: Chart accurately reflects the verified totals

created_roles.name: Delivery Lead
created_roles.description: Project lead responsible for final quality control and delivery of the requested artifacts.
created_roles.prompt: You are the Delivery Lead. Your role is to assemble the final output. Take the PNG chart produced by the Visualization Engineer and present it to the user. Ensure the final response is professional and confirms that the revenue calculations were verified.
created_roles.goal: Assemble and deliver the final PNG chart to the user.
success_criteria: The PNG is delivered and matches the requested specifications

plan.title: Calculate Total Revenue
plan.do: Multiply loads by average revenue for Lanes A, B, C, and D.
plan.done_when: Table contains all 4 lanes with calculated totals.

plan.title: Verify Revenue Totals
plan.do: Cross-reference the Data Analyst's table against the raw shipment data provided in the task.
plan.done_when: All 4 totals are confirmed as mathematically correct.

plan.title: Generate Revenue Chart
plan.do: Use a plotting library to create a bar chart of the verified totals and save it as a PNG.
plan.output: code: Python code to generate PNG
plan.done_when: A PNG file is successfully saved to the environment.

plan.title: Final Assembly
plan.do: Collect the PNG file and present it as the final deliverable.
plan.output: memo: Final delivery message with PNG
plan.done_when: The PNG is delivered to the user.
